title: Russia's constitution calls the state a federative law-governed state with a republican form of government
summary: Russia's constitution calls the state a federative law-governed state with a republican form of government.
body: Article 1, in the English compilation, says the Russian Federation — Russia is a democratic federative law-governed state with a republican form of government, and that the names Russian Federation and Russia are equivalent. The source says: "THE BASIS OF THE CONSTITUTIONAL SYSTEM Article 1 Type of government envisioned The Russian Federation - Russia is a democratic federative law-governed state with a republican form of government." The adjectives are the article's. This card does not grade whether later practice matches them.
